meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会安装 OneCLI 工具，把项目 .env 文件里的密钥搬进 Agent Vault 保管库，再重建并重启服务，让密钥统一由网关管理。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 引入 OneCLI 这个破坏性变更后，或首次设置 OneCLI 时触发。

say.text: 初始化 OneCLI 并迁移 .env 里的密钥
say.note: Claude 会检查现状并开始安装、迁移。
Claude 会重装并重新注册凭据。

say.text: 把 OPENAI_API_KEY 也迁到 OneCLI
say.note: Claude 会询问用途并迁移该密钥。

howto.what_en: Claude installs OneCLI, initializes the Agent Vault, migrates .env credentials into it, then rebuilds and restarts the service so the gateway injects credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.note: Claude will check current state and start.
Claude will reinstall and re-register credentials.
Claude will ask about it and migrate.
